phases.title: Protect authority and baseline
phases.objective: Create immutable decision, visual, storage, migration, bug-reproduction, accessibility, and performance evidence before product implementation.

acceptance.text: Source baseline SHA, authority commit SHA, authority/file hashes, supersession log, and protected-path inventory are verified; all new P00 evidence is present in the exact reviewed patch.
Sanitized v1 storage and backup fixtures cover empty, populated, paid-generated, plan-edit, legacy-vault, malformed, boundary, and large-history cases.
Every documented P0/P1 has an executable reproduction or an explicitly justified manual reproduction.

The exact P0/P1 inventory, 390x844/1024x1366/1440x900 Arabic/English light/dark PNG baseline and WebM/MP4 motion evidence, browser versions, and structured manual attestation are complete without normal tests overwriting them.
Dependencies are pinned with a lockfile and tests/build artifacts are isolated from source assets.

manual_qa: P00-M1: Complete docs/baseline/P00-manual-qa.json from the human-attestation template for the exact matrix in P0-P1-INVENTORY.md using only fake/sanitized financial data.

phases.title: Immediate corruption containment
phases.objective: Fix or visibly block the current prototype workflows that can corrupt, duplicate, erase, or materially misstate financial data.

acceptance.text: Paid generated activity cannot be mutated by plan reconciliation.
Plan apply, import, and cycle settlement are atomic or safely blocked; settlement retry is idempotent.
Unpaid reserved commitments affect cycle availability/settlement and each goal uses only its own allocation.
Legacy vault value, reset blockage, UTC date, historical budget, and import validation risks have regression coverage or temporary containment.
Ordinary capture/export continues to work and no temporary containment is presented as final product design.

docs/baseline/P01-risk-matrix.json maps every canonical P0/P1 ID to an executable regression plus a verified fix or explicit visible dogfooding containment and final owning phase; no listed defect remains silently reachable.

manual_qa: P01-M1: Run ordinary add/edit/export/reload flows and every temporarily blocked danger flow in Arabic and English.

phases.title: Production foundation and mechanical split
phases.objective: Replace the single-file delivery mechanism with a buildable modular Vue/Vite/TypeScript foundation while preserving behavior and legacy data access.

acceptance.text: Production build uses local Vue/assets, a lockfile, lint, typecheck, tests, and CI without runtime CDNs.
Template, styles, storage compatibility, and business logic no longer live as one 10k-line source file.
Current legitimate data opens unchanged and legacy database naming remains preserved.
Characterization screenshots and flows show no unexplained behavioral or visual drift.
New modules have explicit ownership boundaries and no replacement global finance blob.

manual_qa: P02-M1: Compare the modular build to Phase 0 baselines at the locked viewport/language/theme matrix.

phases.title: Canonical finance domain and action registry
phases.objective: Implement the deterministic, currency-aware, cycle-aware financial domain and the single command/action boundary used by UI, import, sync, and AI.

acceptance.text: Money uses checked integer ISO minor units; local civil dates and payday/calendar cycles are explicit.

Availability, mid-cycle boundary, pool/classification completeness, shortfall, pacing, partial/residual obligations, multiple payments, returns, signed reconciliation adjustments, and allocations match the final plan.
Plans cannot rewrite paid facts; cycle close/carry/reopen/backdated propagation and allocation funding/assignment/release are explicit, atomic, and idempotent.
Every mutation passes through a typed command, invariant validation, action receipt, revision/idempotency identity, and undo/reversal policy.

A provider-neutral pre-P04 ADR freezes identity separation, ownership, action/outbox schema, cursors, tombstones, conflict rules, guest merge, sign-out/cache safety, and the authorized provider-amendment path; example, boundary, property, and regression tests exercise production code.

Property/state tests prove the completeness reducer, recovered classified activity, disputed paid/unpaid reservations, expected refunds, timezone/payday effective dates, open-cycle rebase, closed-cycle immutability, UTC/DST/short-month boundaries, retry/reopen behavior, and Reality Check currency invariants: observations/adjustments use the active ISO currency while explicit mismatches or ambiguous symbols yield clarification and no write with no FX.

phases.title: Local data v2, migration, and PWA
phases.objective: Deliver resilient offline guest storage, legacy migration, versioned portability, and installable/update-safe PWA behavior.

acceptance.text: Guest mode reads/writes a disconnected local v2 database and never contacts account/cloud services.

Legacy migration converts canonical SAR major-unit decimals to halalas exactly without rounding, rejects/quarantines excess precision/invalid/ambiguous values, retains original source values, preserves provisional essential reservations and unallocated vault opening value, maps each verified legacy budget settlement to one named carry-in and vault settlement to one allocation funding movement, never infers goal allocations, and survives every fixture/failure point with rollback evidence.
Versioned export/import/reset are atomic, validated, cancelable, and available offline.
Cold installed launch, asset caching, offline reload/write, update lifecycle, two-tab behavior, and recovery pass on automated and physical targets.
Local write and action/outbox receipt are atomic and idempotent.

A physical-device VFS ADR benchmarks IndexedDB and supported cooperative OPFS/per-platform options; the selected adapter passes Safari/iOS/iPadOS/Android/desktop two-tab locking, crash/reload, quota/private-mode, migration, install/update, and rollback gates.

Home/Add/Ask/Plan/Insights/Goals/detail URLs and supported Add/Ask manifest shortcuts preserve destination across refresh, installed offline launch, update, and authentication interruption without false platform claims.

founder_private_use_checkpoint.purpose: Allow visible P05/P06 work after one fake-data iPhone and Android safety pass without claiming full P04 closure or release readiness.
founder_private_use_checkpoint.required_device_pass: Current isolated build: installed launch/update, offline read/write/reopen, persistence, manual export, no-export Factory Reset, import cancellation/rejection/restore, and safe two-tab behavior on iPhone and Android.
founder_private_use_checkpoint.deferred_not_tested: Physical iPadOS, physical quota/private-mode/kill-during-write/newer-schema rollback without a safe harness, and Mac Safari. Original P04-A6 remains open for the full release gate.
founder_private_use_checkpoint.deferred_feature: P04-A7 URL destinations and manifest shortcuts are not a private-use blocker. Keep P04-A7 open; route Home/Add/Plan/Insights/Goals/detail addresses and Add shortcut to the navigation/core-product phase, and Ask/auth-interruption semantics to their later owner phases.

manual_qa: P04-M1: Install/update/offline test on real iOS/iPadOS Safari and Android Chrome; retain structured device/OS attestation and evidence.

phases.title: Design system, locked shell, and Motion Lab
phases.objective: Establish Rushd's bilingual visual system, invariant navigation hierarchy, accessible interaction foundation, and empirically approved signature motion language.
phases.early_start_exception: Founder-approved on 2026-09-23: visible P05/P06 design and core-product work may start after the P04 private-use device checkpoint while strict deferred P04-A6/A7 evidence stays open; this is not P04 closure or permission to publish.

acceptance.text: Home, Plan, Ask Rushd, Insights, and Goals retain the same meaning/order on phone, tablet, and laptop; a persistent Settings action remains outside permanent navigation.

IBM Plex Sans Arabic and Noto Kufi Arabic roles/licenses/self-hosted assets plus English typography, direction, numeric isolation, density, focus, dialogs, safe areas, pointer, keyboard, and touch foundations are documented and tested.
One motion-token/profile source drives Full, Balanced, and OS-overridden Reduced behavior.
All six Motion Lab prototypes have Full/Balanced/Reduced recordings, interaction tests, performance traces, and an explicit selected/rejected decision.
No core behavior or accessible meaning depends on motion; no transition engine competes for the same property.

The frozen 0–4 quality rubric is independently scored for every prototype; selection requires every dimension >=3, distinctiveness and delight =4, cited disagreement resolution, and no behavior/accessibility/performance failure.

manual_qa: P05-M1: Review motion timing and interaction on target physical devices and with VoiceOver/TalkBack and reduced motion; retain structured attestation/evidence.

phases.title: Core product vertical slice
phases.objective: Deliver onboarding, Home, capture, history, availability, reality check, notifications, and daily recovery on the new foundation.

acceptance.text: Fast and field-equivalent guest/manual onboarding paths resume after interruption, enforce the 18+ self-attestation/safe under-18 exit without default full-birth-date collection, confirm timezone/week start, and support mid-cycle boundary semantics, unknown history, import, and later sign-in; Smart Setup is a truthful disabled/preview route until P10.

Home contains the exact final-plan hierarchy, microphone affordance, notification button, View All Transactions, Momentum entry placeholder, and honest sync/offline state; its bilingual accessible Add menu has Manual, Smart text/voice, Flexible preset, and Receipt/photo entries with working manual/preset destinations and truthful pre-P09 availability states.

Manual and saved-preset capture, selected-day activity, and full offline transaction history cover period browsing, search/filter, detail, edit/correct/reverse/undo, linked returns, bulk review, export, and audit receipts with expected items visually separate.

Availability/shortfall, freshness/completeness, explanation, optional pacing, and reality check remain mathematically consistent through every mutation; Reality Check visibly and accessibly names the active ISO currency and its bilingual typed/voice flows reject explicit foreign-currency or ambiguous-symbol observations as clarification-only non-writes.
Flexible-definition links are optional, editable, and monitoring-only; Arabic/English, phone/tablet/laptop, keyboard/touch, a11y, rapid-interaction, and visual gates pass.

manual_qa: P06-M1: Complete manual/fast onboarding and a full daily loop on phone, tablet, and laptop in both languages, including visible/announced active Reality Check currency plus foreign-currency and ambiguous-symbol non-write clarification cases.

phases.title: Plan, reconciliation, Insights, and Goals
phases.objective: Deliver the complete deterministic planning, monitoring, scenario, goal, and cycle-review experience.

acceptance.text: Payday/calendar cycle, commitments, flexible rules/presets, buffer, templates/profiles, preview/apply, and expected-to-actual reconciliation satisfy the financial contract.
Insights answer concrete questions, expose accessible text/table equivalents, inherit completeness and assumptions, and keep actual, expected, pacing, and completeness concepts distinct.
What-if scenarios are deterministic and never present assumptions as affordability guarantees.

Tracked-pool funding, unallocated-to-goal assignment, named-cycle release, and legacy opening allocations cannot double count or imply custody; corrections and cycle close remain auditable/idempotent.
Cycle review, missed-day recovery, plan conflict, closed-period correction, and large-ledger flows pass all gates.

manual_qa: P07-M1: Review a full cycle from setup through close, including shortfall, plan edit after payment, goal reallocation, and recovery after a gap.

phases.title: Accounts, production sync, and cloud lifecycle
phases.objective: Deliver authenticated multi-device sync, safe guest merge, conflict recovery, cloud data rights, and operational backup lifecycle.
phases.human_gate: Provider region/legal decision and founder-owned Supabase/PowerSync credentials are required before production provisioning; local mocks and migrations proceed without them.

acceptance.text: Auth creation/recovery, sessions/devices, RLS, server ownership, transactional write validation, per-identity local cache, and non-bypassable 18+ account boundary pass authorization/privacy tests.

Guest merge is explicit/idempotent, never overwrites remote data silently, and supports Keep Local; sign-out prevents cross-account exposure and cannot erase unacknowledged outbox/conflict intent without verified export plus explicit destructive override.
Two-device edit, delete-vs-edit, duplicate/reordered requests, expired auth, months offline, queue error, and retry-after-timeout converge without loss or duplication.
Conflicts retain local intent and have a usable resolution path; visible sync state never falsely reports Saved.
Cloud export/deletion, backup/PITR, recovery, rollback, retention, and incident runbooks are implemented and drilled.

manual_qa: P08-M1: Use two physical devices and two accounts to verify merge, convergence, offline/failed-sync sign-out cache safety, deletion/export, and recovery.

phases.title: AI platform and smart capture
phases.objective: Deliver an authenticated, evaluated AI proposal platform with text, push-to-talk, batch, correction, matching, and receipt/image capture.
phases.human_gate: Founder-owned candidate-provider projects (including OpenAI), billing controls, server secrets, retention settings, and privacy/legal approval are required before real-data external testing or production provider lock.

acceptance.text: No model/API secret ships to the client; authenticated gateway, limits, redaction, store/retention settings, and kill switch are verified.

Every valid write-capable proposal is schema-valid, deterministically revalidated, previewed, appropriately confirmed, committed only through the action registry, audited, and undoable/reversible as defined; read-only, clarification, refusal, timeout, malformed, stale, failure, explicit foreign-currency Reality Check, and ambiguous-currency outcomes remain truthful non-writes with no FX or active-currency reinterpretation.

The frozen 1,200+ case, 30% holdout publishes denominators/confidence intervals and meets every exact zero-tolerance, first-schema, critical-slot, end-to-end task-success, batch precision/recall, ambiguity, grounding, per-language/modality/capability, noisy-voice, human-review, failure, and regression threshold in the final plan.
Receipt/photo/screenshot extraction meets the exact >=97.5% overall/>=95% condition field thresholds plus privacy, duplicate, crop/rotation, unsupported abstention, and review-correction gates.
Offline behavior is truthful and usable; analytics/error events contain no raw financial or AI content.

The Home Add menu activates Smart text/voice and Receipt/photo without regressing Manual or Flexible preset; all four entries, availability/offline states, and destinations pass bilingual E2E and accessibility tests.

OpenAI and at least one production-eligible alternative run the untouched benchmark; the versioned decision record selects only a hard-gate passer using the frozen 45/20/15/15/5 quality/Arabic-latency/privacy-cost weights, with no provider-specific domain coupling.

manual_qa: P09-M1: Human-review the frozen stratified AI sample and all high-impact/ambiguous proposal experiences in both languages.

phases.title: Ask Rushd and contextual AI
phases.objective: Deliver grounded conversation and broad product control through the four approved AI surfaces.

acceptance.text: Global, Home, contextual, and full-conversation surfaces use one permissioned action/tool contract and coherent history.

Onboarding extraction, plan/goal edits, grounded explanations, what-if, cross-date/cycle batches, clarification, cancellation, multi-step review, and typed/spoken Reality Check currency mismatch or ambiguity non-write handling pass bilingual evals.
Assistant memory/preferences are visible, editable, deletable, scoped, and never infer sensitive traits silently.
Read answers cite the app calculation basis/data-as-of state; action answers cannot bypass confirmation or stale-read checks.
Spoken/full-duplex voice ships only if interruption, latency, privacy, accessibility, and safety thresholds pass; otherwise push-to-talk remains complete.

Smart Setup passes bilingual E2E/a11y for typed/spoken input, ambiguity, accept/edit/skip/manual continuation, one-review confirmation, interruption/resume, sign-in loss/offline fallback, and guest-to-account handoff without a modal trap.

manual_qa: P10-M1: Complete realistic multi-turn financial discussions and cross-domain commands in Arabic, English, and mixed speech.

phases.title: Momentum and full motion application
phases.objective: Deliver the motivating daily check-in system and apply the approved extreme motion language across complete product flows.

acceptance.text: Check-in marks, reviewed-as-of/cutoff/later-activity states, streak, day boundary, 48-hour repair, one earned token, corrected-day behavior, journey, mastery, weekly mission, and rewards are deterministic/idempotent across sync.
No progress depends on money amount, wealth, transaction count, category, screen visit, or destructive recovery exercise; farming tests pass.
Reminder opt-in/suppression/privacy, hide-streak, lapse recovery, pressure feedback, and stop-condition instrumentation are implemented.
Approved signature transitions are applied coherently; rapid interaction, save errors, navigation interruption, and reduced motion never change behavior.
Full/Balanced/Reduced motion passes target-device performance, visual timing, accessibility, memory/leak, and battery-sensitive-loop gates.

Settings/Profile and the Home notification center provide permission timing, independent routine/risk controls, generic lock-screen previews, revocation, motion/account controls, and authenticated/offline-safe focused deep links across RTL/LTR device tests.

manual_qa: P11-M1: Review one full check-in/repair/missed-streak cycle and every signature transition on all physical target classes with structured evidence.

phases.title: Extreme QA, security, performance, and release candidate
phases.objective: Find and fix every release blocker through independent adversarial verification and produce a reproducible release candidate.

acceptance.text: Finance property/mutation, migration, import/export, sync fault, AI eval, authz/security, and backup/restore/rollback gates have no blocker.
Full automated browser/language/theme/motion/viewport/a11y matrix and physical-device PWA matrix pass with retained evidence.
Performance budgets pass with realistic data and no unresolved interaction/motion hotspot or memory leak.
Privacy copy, data controls, telemetry redaction, operational runbooks, incident response, kill switches, and support diagnostics are complete.

The worker checkpoint proves a reproducible release artifact, clean/explained working tree, and no open P0/P1; the mandatory fresh Sol-high phase review occurs only after checkpoint validation through the normal review transition.

manual_qa: P12-M1: Complete structured attestations for the release checklist, physical-device matrix, migration/restore drill, and privacy/security review.

phases.title: Controlled beta and release readiness
phases.objective: Provision approved services, reach beta readiness, run a controlled four-week evidence period, respond through tested changes, and produce the independently auditable public release candidate without deploying it prematurely.
phases.human_gate: Founder approval, billing, credentials, DNS/domain changes, legal/privacy sign-off, beta recruitment, and public deployment are required.

mandatory_human_gates.requirement: P13-BETA: Founder attests that the controlled beta evidence covers at least four complete weeks, includes the pre-registered tester/attrition and Momentum pressure/farming results, freezes any required reduced-scope rerun evidence, and is ready for independent release review.

acceptance.text: Production services, domain, secrets, backups, alerts, staged rollout, rollback, status/support, and release provenance are verified.

Closed beta completes at least four weeks and the pre-registered >=40-tester Momentum gate retains >=16 activated and >=14 two-pulse respondents per randomized arm plus >=28 week-four testers, treats missing responses explicitly, blocks >15-point differential attrition/nonresponse, and passes pressure/farming thresholds; a breach reduces scope and reruns >=2 weeks before release.
Every beta fix passes its relevant phase gate and migration/recovery requirements; no production-only drift exists.

Public claims, 18+ age gate/terms and under-18 safe exit, privacy/terms, deletion/export, support and device policies are legally reviewed and accurate in Arabic and English; the Arabic headline passes the documented eight-user comprehension threshold.
The four-week beta evidence is frozen and a reproducible public release candidate is ready for the five final audits; no public deployment or founder authorization is claimed yet.

At least 12 testers (>=4 Arabic-first, >=4 English-first) rate signature flows; median beauty/fun <4/5 or >=20% same-flow confusion/dizziness/slowness reopens P11 and affected gates before release, with denominators/device/language evidence retained.

manual_qa: P13-M1: Complete beta production smoke, real account/device sync, PWA install/update, AI kill-switch, restore, and rollback drills before final audits.
